observed_failure: MPI reports enormous wrapped expected byte counts (including 2^64-192, consistent with -24 doubles) and processes segfault during Allgatherv; exit 139.
finding: At n=1031 and 128 ranks, ceil partition size is nine. Empty ranks 115 through 127 have start>n but end clamped to n. Unsigned e-s underflows and converts to negative MPI receive counts; for rank 115 the count is -24 doubles. Both in-place MPI_Allgatherv calls use these invalid counts.
interpretation: Pre-existing empty-partition/count-underflow defect independent of concurrent scheduling. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source/count arithmetic and retained MPI diagnostic; no new program execution.
